- REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER generated the highest revenue TW at £4,290.54, followed by PARTY BUNTING at £4,021.56.
- WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER achieved £2,503.60 in revenue TW and led order volume with 62 orders.
- JUMBO BAG RED RETROSPOT delivered £2,339.73 in revenue TW while selling 1,206 units, the third highest unit volume.
- SET/4 WHITE RETRO STORAGE CUBES showed the strongest WoW growth at 2,093% increase in revenue.
- COLOUR GLASS. STAR T-LIGHT HOLDER demonstrated exceptional YoY performance with 1,981.9% revenue growth.
- ASSORTED COLOURS SILK FAN led unit sales TW with 1,618 units, closely followed by SMALL CERAMIC TOP STORAGE JAR at 1,616 units.
- SPOTTY BUNTING generated 67 orders TW, the highest order count, while also contributing £1,971.47 in revenue.
- CHILLI LIGHTS showed strong YoY growth of 1,154.5%, indicating significant year-on-year revenue expansion.
